description: This file is a shell script for testing and managing a git-p4 integration, focusing on RCS keyword handling, scrubbing, and related operations within a version control environment.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Creates Python scripts for scrubbing RCS keywords in files.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Performs scrubbing on a file using the KB script and compares results to check proper handling of RCS keywords.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Performs scrubbing on a file using the KO script, verifying correct handling of specific keyword variations.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Generates a C source file with embedded RCS keywords for testing keyword expansion and scrubbing.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a timestamp comment to a file under P4 control and submits the change.
